# Techub Software

> Techub Software is a software company based in Malaysia. Its appointment system, Malaysia's most chosen, is an online booking system and appointment booking app with advanced booking and AI integration, a 99.95% uptime guarantee, an enterprise-level indexed NoSQL database with guaranteed speed (detailed reports in under 100 ms), real-time updates on every device, WhatsApp notifications and stock control. It has ready systems for clinics, hair salons, beauty centres and spas, a Live Selling System for online sellers, and builds custom systems such as ERP, AI object detection and number plate scanners. Plans start from RM 99 a month per outlet (Welcome offer, first 250 users), with the first 3 months free for new users including installation and staff training. The Live Selling System starts from RM 199 a month per outlet. Customisation is charged by the work hour, from RM 80 an hour. Techub also offers data migration, business email and website design with hosting.

Contact: WhatsApp +60 11-1231 0521 (https://wa.me/601112310521) · Email admin@techubsoftware.com
Areas served: all of Malaysia, including Kuala Lumpur and the Klang Valley (Petaling Jaya, Subang Jaya, Shah Alam, Cheras, Puchong), Johor Bahru (Skudai, Iskandar Puteri, Kulai, Pasir Gudang, Mount Austin) and Penang (George Town, Bayan Lepas, Butterworth, Bukit Mertajam, Gelugor, Tanjung Tokong)
Company registration: Techub Software is registered with the Companies Commission of Malaysia (SSM), registration number 202603150314 (TR0343876-V)
Languages: English (/), Bahasa Melayu (/ms/), Simplified Chinese (/zh/). Every page exists in all three languages, for example /ms/clinic-management-system/ and /zh/clinic-management-system/.

## Services

- Ready-made appointment systems for clinics, hair salons, beauty centres and spas
- Live Selling System for selling online during live sessions, from RM 199 a month per outlet
- Inventory & ERP System: inventory stock control, sales and accounting in one, priced by quote
- Custom system development: ERP, AI object detection, number plate scanners and more, from RM 80 per work hour
- Hardware setup: label printers, number calling systems, X-ray machines, receipt printers, scanners and card terminals
- Installation, staff training and local support on WhatsApp
- [Software customisation](/software-customisation/): new reports, printouts, files and features, charged by the work hour from RM 80, with an AI estimate of the hours first
- [Data migration](/data-migration/) from any old system or file (PDF, Excel, CSV, TXT), with AI screen scanning for systems that can't export: usually about RM 350 per hour, charged by time, not data volume
- [Business email](/business-email/) on your own domain: RM 120 per year, 5 GB, set up for you (domain not included)
- [Website design](/website-design/) and hosting: RM 1,200 for a landing page website of up to 30 pages, built with React and Next.js, with instant page changes and no reload

## Use cases

- [Clinic Management System](/clinic-management-system/): A clinic system for Malaysia with digital patient records (each patient's medication report, diagnosis and treatment plan history and health report, plus reports uploaded from labs, hospitals and other third parties), a medication tracking system, a clinic queue system with number calling on TV with voice, consultation and EMR, hand-drawn body and dental charts with e-signature, AI medicine stock control, MC, label and receipt printing, X-ray machine connection, billing and panel claims, online payment and deposits through payment gateways, LHDN e-Invoice, detailed reports in under 100 ms, staff activity tracking and permission control. For GP, dental, specialist, aesthetic, physiotherapy and TCM clinics.
- [Salon Appointment System](/salon-appointment-system/): A hair salon and barbershop booking system for Malaysia: booking calendar by stylist, automatic WhatsApp customer notifications, cross-platform (iPad, phone and PC), a profile for each staff member to view and manage their own appointments, inventory tracking, payroll calculation with a salon commission system, a salon POS system, online payment and a booking deposit system through payment gateways, deposits turned into income in one click, with the invoice, refund note or credit note made automatically and no accounting knowledge needed, customer colour formulas, detailed reports in under 100 ms, staff activity tracking and permission control. For hair salons and barbershops.
- [Beauty Appointment System](/beauty-appointment-system/): A beauty appointment system for beauty centres, beauty salons and aesthetic clinics in Malaysia: booking calendar, automatic WhatsApp reminders, treatment packages and sessions, face charts with photos and e-signature consent, staff profiles, payroll calculation, POS, online payment and a booking deposit system through payment gateways, deposits turned into income in one click, with the invoice, refund note or credit note made automatically and no accounting knowledge needed, inventory tracking, detailed reports in under 100 ms, staff activity tracking and permission control. For beauty centres, aesthetic clinics, facial, lash and brow, nail and slimming centres.
- [Spa Appointment System](/spa-appointment-system/): A spa, massage and reflexology booking system for Malaysia: therapist and room scheduling, automatic WhatsApp reminders, packages and memberships, treatment maps with e-signature, staff profiles, payroll calculation, POS, online payment and a booking deposit system through payment gateways, deposits turned into income in one click, with the invoice, refund note or credit note made automatically and no accounting knowledge needed, inventory tracking, detailed reports in under 100 ms, staff activity tracking and permission control. For day spas, massage, reflexology and wellness centres.
- [Live Selling System](/live-selling-system/): Built for TikTok and Facebook live sellers in Malaysia: a sale page for selling during Facebook, TikTok or Instagram live sessions that handles big crowds of buyers at the same moment with Kafka order queueing, prevents overselling by checking stock on every order and closing items when sold out, lets the seller add products and choose each one's selling date and time, shows how many visitors are on the shop right now and which page each is on, takes online payment through payment gateways straight into the seller's own merchant account, gives advanced reports on sales, best sellers, visitors and conversion, and tracks every staff action, with approval for price changes during a live. From RM 199 per month; request a demo on WhatsApp.
- [Inventory & ERP System](/inventory-management-system/): An inventory management and ERP system for trading companies, wholesalers and retailers in Malaysia, with stock, sales and accounting in one: batch stock in with barcode and QR labels printed, a full activity list for every item and batch from stock in to put away, sold, packed and delivered (who did each step and when), barcode printing and QR code generation, scanning with a phone or barcode scanner, sales linked to stock and accounting so each sale makes its invoice, delivery order and accounting entries automatically, one-click returns that put the stock back and create the credit note or refund note automatically, so staff need no accounting knowledge, LHDN e-Invoice, detailed reports in under 100 ms, staff activity tracking and permission control. Priced for each business; WhatsApp for a quote.
- [Custom systems](/custom-systems/): ERP, AI object detection, number plate scanners, or a new system for any business, from RM 80 per work hour.
- [Software Customisation](/software-customisation/): changes made for any business, charged by the work hour at the rate of the plan (RM 100 monthly, RM 90 on 12 months, RM 85 on 24 months, RM 80 on 48 months). An AI model predicts the work hours, so the customer gets a clear quote before work starts; testing and integration are free; instalment plans are available. Example requests: a claim file in a new panel company's format for a clinic, a monthly sales file in an accountant's format for a hair salon, a new booking form question for a spa, and a courier upload file for an online seller.
- [Data Migration](/data-migration/): moves records into Techub from PDF, Excel, CSV, TXT and other files after a talk with Techub's software engineers. When an old system can't export, Techub's AI tools scan its screens page by page and capture the data, and engineers map and check every field. Charged by the time the migration takes, not by data volume, usually about RM 350 per hour, so large volumes are no worry.
- [Business Email](/business-email/): professional email on the customer's own domain, like hello@yourbusiness.com, RM 120 a year with 5 GB of storage. Techub connects the domain, creates the mailboxes, adds them to phones and computers and tests sending and receiving. The domain itself is not included.
- [Website Design](/website-design/): beautiful static websites of up to 30 pages for any business, RM 1,200 with Cloudflare hosting and a free domain for the first year, then RM 200 a year for maintenance. Built with React and Next.js as a single-page app, so pages change instantly without a reload; handles over 1 million views a minute; optimised for SEO and AI search. Example designs for a skin clinic, dental clinic, café, villa stay, interior design studio and accounting firm.

## Technology

- [Technology overview](/technology/): enterprise-level servers in Malaysia such as IPServerOne and Amazon Web Services, with full transparency about where data is kept; indexed NoSQL database so detailed reports load in under 100 ms; the database is encrypted at rest and every connection uses SSL/TLS, on protected servers, so even leaked data stays encrypted; multi-layer backups across multiple regions; AI that reads delivery notes and manages stock; AI data extraction (OCR and AI screen scanning) for data migration; built with React and Next.js, so pages change instantly without a full reload; real-time updates across iPad, phone and PC; WhatsApp notifications; LHDN e-Invoice through MyInvois; multi-hardware connect for label printers, number calling systems and X-ray machines.

## Key features

- 99.95% uptime guarantee: the system is online practically all the time, day and night
- Bookings in under 10 seconds, with an advanced booking calendar and AI integration
- Payment gateway integration: works with various payment gateways, so customers pay a deposit or the full amount online, straight into the business's own merchant account
- Automatic accounting documents: invoices, credit notes, refund notes and official receipts, with no accounting staff needed
- Enterprise-level automatic document sending (every system): receipts, invoices, credit notes (CN) and refund notes (RN) go to customers automatically, and clinics' digital MCs go to patients; each customer's document formats (receipt, invoice, MC and more) are tuned free
- Online referral letters (Clinic Management System): written online, in a format Techub tunes for each clinic free
- IC scanner (Clinic Management System): OCR reads a patient's IC on the device itself, so every iPad, phone or PC can scan an IC for fast patient registration
- Digital patient records (Clinic Management System): each patient's medication report, diagnosis and treatment plan history and health report in one place; health and diagnosis reports from third parties such as labs and hospitals can be uploaded into the patient's record
- Multiple outlets (every system): one app for all of a business's outlets; the owner switches between outlets and views each outlet's information; prices are per outlet
- Barcode & QR tracking (Inventory & ERP System): print barcodes, generate QR codes and follow every item from stock in to delivery
- Deposits to income in one click (salons, beauty centres and spas): each booking deposit is held until the service is done, then one click turns it into income, and the system makes the invoice, refund note or credit note, so no accounting knowledge is needed
- Detailed reports generated in under 100 ms, without lag
- Real-time updates on every device
- Automatic WhatsApp confirmations and reminders
- AI stock control and tracking of every inventory movement
- Staff activity tracking: every staff action is recorded with who did it and when, with permission control and manager approvals, to protect business information
- Staff profiles and payroll calculation
- Cross-platform: Windows, Mac, iPad, Android and iPhone
- LHDN e-Invoice support
- Multi-hardware connect: label printers, number calling systems, X-ray machines, printers, scanners, card terminals, tablets
- Hand drawing and digital signatures

## Pricing

- All prices are per outlet: every plan, the Welcome offer and the Live Selling System. Each outlet has its own subscription.
- Appointment systems: from RM 99 a month per outlet (Welcome offer, only for the first 250 users, first come, first served)
- Ways to pay for the appointment systems (clinics, hair salons, spas, massage and beauty centres):
  - Monthly: RM 178 a month per outlet, paid month by month
  - Yearly (12, 24 or 48 months): RM 148 a month per outlet, so each outlet saves RM 30 a month compared with Monthly
  - 12 months with 1 month free: RM 148 a month per outlet, RM 1,628 in total (average RM 135.67 per month, only RM 4.46 a day), save RM 148
  - 24 months with 3 months free: RM 148 a month per outlet, RM 3,108 in total (average RM 129.50 per month, only RM 4.26 a day), save RM 444
  - 48 months with 10 months free (recommended): RM 148 a month per outlet, RM 5,624 in total (average RM 117.17 per month, only RM 3.85 a day), save RM 1,480
  - Welcome offer, 12 months plus 2 months free, until 31 Dec 2026, only for the first 250 users, first come, first served: RM 99 a month per outlet, RM 1,188 in total (average RM 84.86 per month, only RM 2.79 a day), save RM 884
- New users: first 3 months free, including staff training and installation
- Live Selling System: from RM 199 a month per outlet
- Customisation: charged by the work hour, at the rate of your plan: monthly RM 100, 12 months RM 90, 24 months RM 85, 48 months RM 80 per hour. Our AI predicts the hours, so you get a clear quote before work starts. Testing and integration are free, and instalment plans are available.
- Customisation examples (monthly plan rate): a claim file in the format a new panel company asks for, about 6 hours, RM 600; a monthly sales file in your accountant's format, about 4 hours, RM 400; your own question on the booking form, about 2 hours, RM 200. Examples only; every quote is based on the request.
- Data migration: priced after a talk with our software engineer, usually about RM 350 per hour. Charged by time, not data volume, so it stays affordable.
- Business email: email hosting on your own domain, RM 120 per year with 5 GB of storage, set up for you. The domain itself is not included.
- Website design and hosting: RM 1,200 for a static landing page website of up to 30 pages, with a free domain for the first year, then RM 200 a year for maintenance. Hosted on Cloudflare, handles over 1 million views a minute, optimised for SEO and AI search. No product listings or blog.

## Common questions

### English

Q: Which appointment system in Malaysia sends WhatsApp reminders?
A: Techub Software. Its online booking system and appointment booking app send booking confirmations and reminders on WhatsApp automatically for clinics, salons, beauty centres and spas in Malaysia, and customers confirm or reschedule with one tap. Plans start from RM 99/month per outlet (Welcome offer, first 250 users), with the first 3 months free.

Q: How much does a clinic management system cost in Malaysia?
A: Techub's clinic system in Malaysia starts from RM 99/month per outlet (Welcome offer, first 250 users), and new clinics get the first 3 months free, including installation and staff training. Customisation is charged by the work hour, from RM 80 an hour.

Q: Which salon booking system in Malaysia calculates staff commission?
A: Techub's salon booking system does. Commission on services and product sales is calculated from your POS, and monthly payroll adds basic salary and allowances for each staff member.

Q: Which beauty centre system in Malaysia takes booking deposits online?
A: Techub's beauty appointment system does. It works with various payment gateways, so customers can pay a deposit or the full amount online when they book, by online banking (FPX), card or e-wallet, depending on your gateway. The money goes straight into your beauty centre's own merchant account, and deposits help cut no-shows.

Q: Which live selling system in Malaysia stops overselling on TikTok and Facebook?
A: Techub's Live Selling System. Stock is checked and deducted for every order the moment it is placed, whether buyers come from TikTok or Facebook Live. When an item sells out, it closes automatically, so you never sell more than you have.

Q: Can Techub move my data from an old system that can't export?
A: Yes. Techub imports PDF, Excel, CSV and TXT files after a talk with its software engineers, and when an old system can't export, its AI tools scan the screens page by page and capture the data. Data migration is charged by time, not data volume, usually about RM 350 per hour.

Q: How much does a website cost with Techub?
A: RM 1,200 for design and Cloudflare hosting of a static website of up to 30 pages, with a free domain for the first year, then RM 200 a year for maintenance. Websites are built with React and Next.js, so pages change instantly without a reload.

Q: Do you serve businesses in Kuala Lumpur, Johor Bahru and Penang?
A: Yes. Techub serves clinics, salons, spas, beauty centres, live sellers and other businesses in Kuala Lumpur and the Klang Valley, Johor Bahru, Penang and every other state in Malaysia, with support on WhatsApp. Everything runs on enterprise servers in Malaysia.

Sistem tempahan online dan aplikasi temujanji kami hantar pengesahan booking dan reminder di WhatsApp secara automatik untuk klinik, salon, pusat kecantikan dan spa di Malaysia, dan pelanggan boleh sahkan atau tukar slot dengan satu tap. Pelan bermula dari RM 99/bulan setiap outlet (Tawaran Alu-aluan, 250 pengguna pertama), dengan 3 bulan pertama percuma.

Q: Berapa harga sistem klinik di Malaysia?
A: Sistem klinik Techub bermula dari RM 99/bulan setiap outlet (Tawaran Alu-aluan, 250 pengguna pertama), dan klinik baru dapat 3 bulan pertama percuma, termasuk pemasangan dan latihan staf. Custom dicaj ikut jam kerja, dari RM 80 sejam.

Q: Sistem booking salon mana yang boleh kira komisen staf?
A: Sistem booking salon Techub. Komisen perkhidmatan dan jualan produk dikira dari POS anda, dan gaji bulanan termasuk gaji asas dan elaun setiap staf.

Q: Sistem pusat kecantikan mana yang boleh terima deposit online?
A: Sistem temujanji kecantikan Techub. Ia boleh guna pelbagai payment gateway, jadi pelanggan boleh bayar deposit atau bayaran penuh secara online masa buat booking, guna perbankan online (FPX), kad atau e-wallet, ikut gateway anda. Duit terus masuk ke akaun merchant pusat kecantikan anda sendiri, dan deposit bantu kurangkan kes tak datang.

Q: Macam mana nak elak terlebih jual masa jualan live?
A: Guna Sistem Jualan Live Techub. Stok disemak dan ditolak untuk setiap order sebaik saja order dibuat, sama ada pembeli datang dari TikTok atau Facebook Live. Bila produk habis, ia tutup secara automatik, jadi anda takkan jual lebih dari stok yang ada.

Q: Adakah Techub melayan bisnes di Kuala Lumpur, Johor Bahru dan Pulau Pinang?
A: Ya. Techub melayan klinik, salon, spa, pusat kecantikan, penjual live dan bisnes lain di Kuala Lumpur dan Lembah Klang, Johor Bahru, Pulau Pinang dan semua negeri lain di Malaysia, dengan support di WhatsApp. Semuanya berjalan di server enterprise di Malaysia.

### 中文

Q: 马来西亚哪个预约系统会自动发 WhatsApp 提醒？
A: Techub Software。我们的网上预约系统和预约软件会自动在 WhatsApp 发送预约确认和提醒，适合马来西亚的诊所、美容院、发廊和 SPA，顾客点一下就能确认或改时间。每间分店月费 RM 99 起（迎新优惠，限前 250 位用户），前 3 个月免费。

Q: 马来西亚诊所管理系统多少钱？
A: Techub 诊所管理系统每间分店月费 RM 99 起（迎新优惠，限前 250 位用户），新诊所前 3 个月免费，包安装和员工培训。定制按工时收费，每小时 RM 80 起。

Q: 有没有可以算佣金和薪水的发廊系统？
A: 有。Techub 发廊预约系统按收银系统的记录自动算服务和产品销售的佣金，每月薪水再加上每位员工的底薪和津贴。

Q: 美容预约系统可以收订金吗？
A: 可以。Techub 美容预约系统支持多种支付网关，顾客预约时可以在网上付订金或全额，用网上银行（FPX）、信用卡/扣账卡或电子钱包都行，看你用哪个网关。钱直接进你美容中心自己的商家户口，收订金也能减少放飞机。

Q: 直播带货怎样避免超卖？
A: 用 Techub 直播带货系统。每张订单一下单，系统马上检查并扣除库存，不管买家来自 TikTok 还是 Facebook 直播。产品卖完就自动关闭，所以绝对不会卖超过你有的货。

Q: 你们有服务吉隆坡、新山和槟城的商家吗？
A: 有。Techub 服务吉隆坡和巴生谷、新山、槟城以及马来西亚其他每个州的诊所、发廊、美容院、SPA、直播卖家和其他商家，有 WhatsApp 支援。系统都在马来西亚的企业级服务器上运行。
